sql:
with t as (
 select p.market_ticker mt, split_part(p.market_ticker,'-',2) d, p.created_at, p.assumed_price px, p.quantity q, p.pnl, p.status, s.close_time
 from paper_trades p left join mmsell_settlement_meta s on s.market_ticker=p.market_ticker
 where p.market_ticker like 'KXRAIN-%' and p.strategy like '%mmsell%' and p.strategy not like '%\_pt%' and p.status='settled' and p.side='no'
), m as (
 select mt, d, min(created_at) fe, max(close_time) ct, max(case when pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end) lost, sum(q) q, sum(pnl) pnl, count(*) n
 from t where px>=93 group by 1,2
), dd as (select d, count(*) mk, sum(lost) l from m group by 1)
select 'month' dim, to_char(fe,'YYYY-MM') k, count(*) mkts, count(distinct d) dates, sum(lost) lost, round(100.0*sum(lost)/count(*),2) real_yes, round(100*sum(pnl)/sum(q),2) c_ct from m group by 2
union all select 'htc', case when extract(epoch from ct-fe)/3600<6 then '0-6h' when extract(epoch from ct-fe)/3600<12 then '06-12h' when extract(epoch from ct-fe)/3600<24 then '12-24h' else '24h+' end, count(*), count(distinct d), sum(lost), round(100.0*sum(lost)/count(*),2), round(100*sum(pnl)/sum(q),2) from m group by 2
union all select 'all','all',count(*),count(distinct d),sum(lost),round(100.0*sum(lost)/count(*),2),round(100*sum(pnl)/sum(q),2) from m
union all select 'mkts_per_date', mk::text, count(*), count(*), sum(l), null, null from dd group by mk
order by 1,2
